Speaker: Speaker 18
Text: There are some emergencies in our community  that are easy to see,  and we have emergency responders who know exactly what to do if there is a house burning down, or a car accident or a medical emergency. Text: So I'll admit, a few years ago, if I saw someone on the street who was struggling, I'd probably be one of those people that just walked on by. And,  you know, there's really no excuse. Text: And I think these emergency needs are really hard to address when you're just one person and you have no training or experience in these issues. Text: So together they formed the warm welcome shelter at Trinity Church.  We offered simply a folding cot, something to eat and drink, and some dry clothes.  It became not just a place to sleep.
